blocks.text: MANILA – The weather bureau said Saturday that the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) and the easterlies continue to bring rains to a large part of the country. Scattered rains and thunderstorms are expected over Mindanao, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, Cebu, and Palawan due to the ITCZ, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration […]...
